question.text: Under SEBI regulations, what is the requirement regarding uniformity of NAV applicable to all investors on a given day?

answer.text: All investors must get the same NAV for purchase or redemption on a given business day, subject to cut-off timing rules
Institutional investors get a preferential NAV compared to retail investors
The AMC can offer a discounted NAV to large investors as a volume benefit
Different NAVs can apply to different investors based on the channel of investment

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series V-A workbook, purchase and redemption prices depend on the applicable NAV and the cut-off time (p100), and fair valuation principles ensure fair treatment to all investors transacting in the scheme (p136). The uniformly applicable cut-off rules (p190-p191) mean all investors transacting on a given business day under the same cut-off window receive the same NAV. The Trap: Options B, C and D imply preferential or channel-based NAV pricing, which is inconsistent with the fair-treatment principle and uniform cut-off rules. The applicable NAV is determined by the time of valid application (and, for purchases, fund realisation) — not by investor size, type or channel. Note: The combination of standardised cut-off timings and fair-valuation principles is what enforces a single applicable NAV per cut-off window for all investors in the scheme.
